_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. CA Total en hero, puis nouveaux segments (BOE plus gros), Advisory, Project Mgmt, REI. BOE et PM sont recasts FY23-FY25 suite a reorganisation janvier 2025.

kpis.signal: Croissance solide +13%, depasse $40Md, momentum BOE et Advisory leasing capital markets
kpis.description_fr: CA consolide CBRE Group. Croissance pluriannuelle malgre cycle real estate 2023. Inclut les 4 segments: Advisory Services, Building Operations Experience (BOE), Project Management, Real Estate Investments.
kpis.description_en: CBRE Group consolidated revenue. Multi-year growth despite 2023 real estate cycle. Includes 4 segments: Advisory Services, Building Operations Experience (BOE), Project Management, Real Estate Investments.

kpis.signal: Nouveau segment janvier 2025 (facilities mgmt + property mgmt), plus gros segment CBRE par CA, recurring contractuel
kpis.description_fr: Segment BOE cree janvier 2025 suite acquisition Industrious. Combine Facilities Management (CA 20,645 FY25) et Property Management (2,579). Modele recurring contractuel a forte stickiness.
kpis.description_en: BOE segment created Jan 2025 post-Industrious acquisition. Combines Facilities Management ($20,645M FY25) and Property Management ($2,579M). Contractual recurring sticky model.

kpis.signal: Rebond capital markets, leasing +15%, sales +20%, segment historique haute marge
kpis.description_fr: Revenus segment Advisory Services FY25: Leasing $4,497M, Valuation $815M, Loan servicing $503M, Other portfolio $354M, Advisory sales $2,120M, Commercial mortgage origination $551M. Cyclique mais marge SOP solide.
kpis.description_en: Advisory Services FY25: Leasing $4,497M, Valuation $815M, Loan servicing $503M, Other portfolio $354M, Advisory sales $2,120M, Commercial mortgage origination $551M. Cyclical, high SOP margin.

kpis.signal: Turner Townsend majoritaire, croissance UK/Amerique du Nord/Moyen-Orient, segment contractuel
kpis.description_fr: Segment Project Management cree janvier 2025 (Turner Townsend + business project mgmt CBRE). Croissance UK, Amerique du Nord, Moyen-Orient. Program management, project management, cost consultancy.
kpis.description_en: Project Management segment created Jan 2025 (Turner Townsend + CBRE project mgmt). Growth in UK, North America, Middle East. Program / project mgmt and cost consultancy.

kpis.signal: Investment Mgmt $602M + Development services $277M, baisse development pipeline FY25
kpis.description_fr: Segment Real Estate Investments. Investment Management (IM, $155.5Md AUM) $602M FY25 + Development Services (Trammell Crow) $277M FY25. Volatile car lie aux dispositions et carry.
kpis.description_en: REI segment. Investment Management ($155.5B AUM) $602M FY25 + Development Services (Trammell Crow) $277M FY25. Volatile due to dispositions and carried interest.

kpis.signal: $155.5Md AUM, l'une des principales plateformes mondiales actifs reels institutionnels
kpis.description_fr: AUM Investment Management CBRE au 31/12/2025. Plateforme leader real assets institutionnel (immobilier, infrastructure, MLPs). Pension funds, assureurs, fonds souverains.
kpis.description_en: CBRE Investment Management AUM at Dec 31, 2025. Leading institutional real assets platform (real estate, infrastructure, MLPs). Pension funds, insurers, sovereign wealth.
